card.name: Past-tense verb after 'have' in warnings
card.fires_on: The past participle right after 'have' or 'has' (experienced, developed, occurred) in warning statements about adverse events seen in patients.

modes.label: occurred
modes.description: 'have/has occurred' after an event or condition in a warnings section.
modes.example: These events have<< occurred>> as both new onset and an exacerbation

modes.label: experienced or developed
modes.description: 'have experienced' or 'have developed' after patients or a condition.
